import json,hashlib,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); pkg=root/'review/semantic-kernel/sprint11/planning/grok-gpt6-r1'
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
anchor=json.loads((pkg/'ANCHOR.json').read_text()); manifest=json.loads((pkg/'MANIFEST.json').read_text()); inv=json.loads((pkg/'source-inventory.json').read_text())
assert sha((pkg/'MANIFEST.json').read_bytes())==anchor['manifest_sha256']=='3da1ced3f2ed23b77ec328432406d8b2442f5a5ea62197a570ec7cee865352cf'
assert sha((pkg/'source-inventory.json').read_bytes())==anchor['inventory_sha256']=='ae7df5fc22fc3c4665dc6911ac18653e38f931c9856b03af072d7e217b06b780'
assert sha((pkg/'package.py').read_bytes())=='7db189f935b8fc6ec5497c1a80f5df9ede7de00e1cff9f58f8413b46d720168b'
def snapshot():
 paths={root/r['path'] for r in inv['rows']} | {p for p in pkg.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
 return {str(p.relative_to(root)):{'sha256':sha(p.read_bytes()),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'mtime_ns':p.stat().st_mtime_ns} for p in sorted(paths)}
before=snapshot(); start=time.monotonic()
command=['python3','review/semantic-kernel/sprint11/planning/grok-gpt6-r1/package.py','--check']
r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60)
after=snapshot(); changes=[p for p in sorted(set(before)|set(after)) if before.get(p)!=after.get(p)]
print(json.dumps({'command':command,'cwd':str(root),'exit':r.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr,'source_and_package_files_snapshotted':len(before),'package_files':sum(1 for p in pkg.rglob('*') if p.is_file()),'snapshot_before_sha256':sha(json.dumps(before,sort_keys=True).encode()),'snapshot_after_sha256':sha(json.dumps(after,sort_keys=True).encode()),'bytes_size_mtime_unchanged':before==after,'changed_paths':changes},indent=2))
assert r.returncode==0 and before==after
